atoms.title: Tumbleweeds: A Nuisance to the Department of Agriculture

atoms.text: Tumbleweeds are often seen in old westerns and represent the Wild West. They are an iconic symbol of the United States in films and TV shows. They also happen to be a huge nuisance for the Department of Agriculture and farmers around the United States. Tumbleweeds are plants that break away from their roots, tumble around in the wind and lose seeds on the way. Some tumbleweeds are invasive species that have taken over most of the US, as well as Canada and Mexico. Invasive species are plants or animals that are not originally from the place they are currently in and are often destructive and dangerous to the indigenous plants and animals in the habitat.

hint.text: The Department of Agriculture is a department of the US government that is in charge of laws and programmes related to agriculture, food safety, national parks and rural areas.
hint.label: Department of Agriculture

atoms.text: Tumbleweeds are a huge nuisance because they spread quickly and are almost impossible to get rid of. Adult tumbleweeds sacrifice themselves by starving themselves, so that they can dry out and spread their seeds. One single tumbleweed can have more than 10,000 seeds, which it spreads while it rolls, each bump spreading more seeds. One single tumbleweed can cause an exponential increase in tumbleweeds in the area.

hint.text: The word exponential means a continuous, rapid increase.
hint.label: Exponential

atoms.text: They are nearly impossible to get rid of because they are covered with many sharp thorns, which makes it painful to remove them by hand. Unfortunately, they cannot be removed using machines either, as they are extremely flammable because of how light and dry they are. They also like to stick to one another, which sometimes means that there are huge piles of thorny, flammable bushes that can get big enough to cover cars and even houses!

Tumbleweeds are terrible for farmers, because they kill off crops. Tumbleweeds steal nutrients from crops so that they cannot grow. They also harm work animals and break farm machines during harvest time. Efforts to stop the tumbleweeds from spreading have been futile. Tumbleweeds are one of the worst plants in the United States and have absolutely no value.

hint.text: Futile means not producing a result, or pointless.
hint.label: Futile
